description:
Ferragamo presents “Un Passo alla Volta”, a short film written by Simone Coppo and Martina Ferragamo, directed by Simone Coppo.
Starring Martina Ferragamo, Margherita Buy, Francesco Colella and Francesco Centorame, with executive production by Image Hunters.

Born from an original idea by Martina Ferragamo and Simone Coppo, the film will premiere on 9 September 2026 at Teatro La Fenice in Venice, during the 83rd Venice International Film Festival.

The story takes its cue from a simple, universal question: how do you find your own path when everything moves fast and seems already set? When the past seems to have already taken a precise direction?

In a society that often pushes us to take two steps at once, “Un Passo alla Volta” tells the story of the value of beginnings, of listening, and of the time needed to transform a legacy into a personal choice.

Discover more: http://ferragamo.site/FerragamoUnPassoAllaVolta

description:
Now screening, Cinema Ferragamo in our store in the El Palacio de Hierro Polanco Mall in Mexico City.

Inspired by the elegance of Italian movie theaters, the in-store installation invites visitors to be transported into a world of ballet, Italian cinema and Ferragamo's timeless ballerina, first designed in the 1920s. Salvatore Ferragamo designed custom ballerinas for Hollywood icons including Audrey Hepburn, Greta Garbo, Marilyn Monroe and Ingrid Bergman in the 50s.

Famous ballerinas such as Katherine Dunham, Alicia Markova, Anna Pavlova, Colette Marchand and Agnes de Mille also became Ferragamo clients, highlighting the iconic shoe as a symbol of grace and artistry.

The Cinema Ferragamo installation is open until November 23.
Discover more at the link: http://ferragamo.site/FerragamoDancingThroughLife_YouTube

Unravel the Storie di Seta, a new perfume anthology inspired by the evocative and alluring silk creations from the house of Ferragamo.

Visual artist Nikolina Petolas spins elaborate fantasies that rhythmize a memorable narrative of daydreaming populated with giant animals, towering trees and vivid flowers that ultimately come together in the final groupage starring a never-seen-before landscape where the ocean meets the jungle, and the whale flies with hummingbirds.

Salvatore Ferragamo leaps forward to shape a new now. Inspired by the limitless conceptual freedom of science fiction and the house’s heritage of technical innovation, creative director Paul Andrew projects into the future to craft an alternative vision for the present. 

Paul Andrew says: “In fashion, the past exerts a gravity - we are always drawn to it. For this season I wanted to invert that physics. The objective was to engineer a collection that sees the present through a prism of the future – unleashing a multitude of fresh perspectives. Pre-millennial sci-fi classics Gattaca, Until The End Of The World, and The Matrix were all cinematic influences - past imaginings of the future that have shaped today.

description:
Cut directly by Oscar-nominated director Luca Guadagnino from his atmospheric collection film, Salvatore Ferragamo’s campaign for Spring-Summer 2021 is a masterpiece of suspenseful refinement. The portfolio of stills and short video curated by Guadagnino alongside Salvatore Ferragamo Creative Director Paul Andrew draws from the Alfred Hitchcock inspired film, set in Milan, that was shown before the fashion show in September 2020. Conceived as both an homage to Hollywood — the site of our founder’s first success — and to Milan — the location of 21st Century Salvatore Ferragamo’s fashion expression — the campaign combines our heritage of artistic artisanship and technical innovation.

Guadagnino’s ensemble is Mariacarla Boscono, Maggie Cheng, Jonas Glöer, Samer Rahma and Anok Yai. The alchemy of the director's eye brings them together in a series of meaningful mise-en-scenes that are ripe with intrigue and suspense, and in which Paul Andrew's beautiful Technicolor hued-designs co-star. The monocolor slingback VIVA, reborn F-wedge, and mens’ Gancini driving shoe serve as footwear foundation for powerfully co-ordinated ready-to-wear looks in femme fatale black nappa, powder blue chambray tailoring and heriocally perforated white leather jacketing for men. description:
Salvatore Ferragamo presents Rising in Hollywood - a portfolio of four short films dedicated to showcasing the insights, emotions and ambitions of a new wave of female creatives and entrepreneurs. The campaign stars a diverse group of women; Sinead Bovell, Bonnie Chen, Cuba Tornado Scott, and Gillian Zinser. What they share is a common attraction to the creative gravity exerted by Hollywood; its openness, its possibilities, and its potential for the realisation of dreams. 

Co-starring alongside Bovell, Chen, Scott and Zinser are two emerging forces in the Salvatore Ferragamo portfolio. The Ferragamo Pump is a reworked and modernised upgrade on a house classic, while the new Trifolio bag offers 21st-century versatility expressed via Ferragamo’s artisanal expertise. Both are intimately linked to the creative lineage that connects Salvatore Ferragamo back to its earliest incarnation as the “Shoemaker of Dreams”.
title: Rising in Hollywood ft. Bonnie Chen | Salvatore Ferragamo

description:
After two years of complex and meticulous restoration work, Salvatore Ferragamo is proud to announce that the Fountain of Neptune - one of Florence’s most beloved monuments - has been restored to its former glory on March 2019. 

Ferruccio Ferragamo, President of the Salvatore Ferragamo Group announced, “It has been a privilege for our company to support this important restoration project and see this work of art restored in its full splendour to Florence, its residents and the many travellers from around the world This is the result of a virtuous partnership between the public and private sectors and it is our family’s way of thanking the city and upholding the close relationship that my mother and father forged with it."
title: Salvatore Ferragamo | Fountain of Neptune Restoration

description:
Salvatore Ferragamo celebrates Italian Excellence, through a unique collaboration with four dynamic talents, whose creations embody the values of Italian culture, craft and heritage. The new men’s eyewear collection, titled #ItalianExcellence, blends ultra-modern materials with a contemporary design inspired by archival shapes of the fifties and sixties. 

A graduate of Milan’s Istituto Europeo of Design in Industrial Design, Meda has followed the family tradition set by his father Alberto and evolved into one of Italy’s most exciting emerging talents in his field. Meda invited Ferragamo to film as he works alongside Italian artisans and assesses the elemental raw materials - leather, fabrics, metal - from which he fashions pieces based on a theory of ‘natural design’.
title: Italian Excellence | Ep.2 Francesco Meda

description:
Salvatore Ferragamo celebrates Italian Excellence, through a unique collaboration with four dynamic talents, whose creations embody the values of Italian culture, craft and heritage. 

Derek Castiglioni is a landscape designer who learned the secrets of the plants at his family’s plant-nursery company in Lake Como. With a background in architecture, he sees no distinction in interpreting outer or internal spaces, as accuracy in designing is equally precious for both. He draws inspiration from the 50’s aesthetics, gradually transforming them into his contemporary vision of some of Milan’s most luscious secret gardens.
title: Italian Excellence | Ep.1 Derek Castiglioni

description:

The new men’s eyewear collection, titled #ItalianExcellence, blends ultra-modern materials with a contemporary design inspired by archival shapes of the fifties and sixties. 

Since his first public exhibition in 2009 at the age of 21, Guido Taroni has built a rich portfolio of work based on chromatic harmony and dynamic simplicity. We see Taroni as he scouts Milan in search of inspirational locations that will reflect the inherent values of his creative philosophy, which he defines as a vision of “Italian-ness” built around communal standards of excellence, integrity and quality.
title: Italian Excellence | Ep.3 Guido Taroni

description:

description: A traditional handcrafting process, Tramezza represents the ultimate in men’s handcrafted footwear. The procedure entails a thick yet flexible layer of leather (as opposed to more widely used cork) being skillfully sandwiched between the insole and the sole, like a cushion. The name of this extra sole is tramezza [meaning literally ‘something in-between’] and offers long-lasting form, comfort, and perfect bonding of sole and upper, and becomes the defining feature of the shoe. The highly complex construction process carried out in the Salvatore Ferragamo workshops has 260 separate, standardized phases requiring over six hours work by an expert shoemaker and over four days shaping of the upper on a last.
title: Salvatore Ferragamo - Tramezza MTO
